26.10.14 Greatest common divisor [numeric.ops.gcd]
🔗
template<class M, class N>
  constexpr common_type_t<M, N> gcd(M m, N n);
1
#
Mandates: M and N both are integer types other than
cv bool.
2
#
Preconditions: |m| and |n|
are representable as a value of common_type_t<M, N>.
 [Note 1: These requirements ensure, for example,
that gcd(m, m)=|m|
is representable as a value of type M.
 — end note]
3
#
Returns: Zero when m and n are both zero.
 Otherwise,
returns the greatest common divisor of |m| and |n|.
4
#
Throws: Nothing.
